summary: Cache the pinned Ghostty Zig dependencies and terminal library for Linux CI

rules.detail: No runtime rules or required merge gates change.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing PTY contract and unchanged derivations.

manual.detail: CI only. Publishing skips when the cache-scoped CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN repository secret is absent; public cache reads need no credential.

recovery.detail: The first realization of a changed contract still fetches upstream dependencies.
